savedOn: Saved the check for {{date}}. See it in Results.
suggested: Suggested from what was taught since the last check. A check covers at most two concepts.
nothingNew: Nothing new has been taught since the last check. Pick what to check.
title: Check on {{date}}
discardConfirm: Discard this check and everything entered in it?
absentHelp: Tap to mark. Absent children get no boxes and are never marked wrong.
hindiSkip: Children who speak Hindi at home skip this box.
enterAnswers: {{step}}. Enter the answers from the slates
enterHelp: Photograph five to eight slates at a time, or type the answers. Leave a box empty if the child left it blank.

flags.boxes_one: {{count}} highlighted box needs checking. Tap it, and fix it if it's wrong.
flags.boxes_other: {{count}} highlighted boxes need checking. Tap each one, and fix it if it's wrong.
flags.missing: No slate found for roll {{list}}. Photograph them again, or type their answers.
flags.duplicate: More than one slate says roll {{list}}. The last photo's answers are shown, so check whose slate is whose.

unplaced.title: Whose slate is this?
unplaced.help: These slates couldn't be matched to a child for sure. Pick whose each one is.

photos.offline: No signal: these photos will be read when the phone is back online.

camera.noCamera: This browser can't open the camera here. Choose photos from the gallery instead.
camera.failed: Couldn't open the camera ({{error}}). Choose photos from the gallery instead.
